# Astronomical 0.2.74
## Fixed
- Very long conversations no longer crash the engine on Macs with 48 GB of RAM or more. A conversation grown past roughly one hundred thousand tokens could fail with a native out-of-memory and leave the model unavailable until the app was restarted; the engine now plans strictly within the memory the graphics driver can keep locked for the GPU, and oversized conversations degrade gracefully — part of the model streams — instead of the engine stopping. - Serving memory now adapts to the machine: when the graphics driver's lockable budget is below the configured memory ceiling, plans are made against the lockable budget. Machines already configured inside the lockable budget are unaffected.
## Compatibility
- No configuration changes; existing installs upgrade in place and keep their models and state. Model output semantics and precision are unchanged. The `ASTRONOMICAL_MLX_WIRED_CLAIM=0` escape hatch still keeps model memory pageable for workflows that need it.
## Distribution
- This release is signed with a Developer ID identity, notarized by Apple, and stapled. The disk image and the automatic-update feed are signed, and their SHA-256 digests are recorded in the release manifest before publication.
